reviews.t: Inexpensive product that works with practice
reviews.x: I received these hairstyle buns for free to test and evaluate. The following is my unbiased review after testing them.  These items are "good". They are an inexpensive item and it is expected that they will be inexpensively made. Rather like purchasing a scooter vs a BMV. There are "better quality" hair bun clips that can be purchased, they cost around $5-9 each and do the exact same job as this less expensive set. That said, I am going to discuss the pros and the cons of these.

reviews.t: It works great!!!
reviews.x: Honest to God, I bought these thinking no way it would work. And I'm glad I was wrong. I have super thick, long, curly hair. Imagine a 3 foot wool rug on your head. That's my hair. I cannot believe these actually hold my hair. Plus, I'm crappy at doing hair. But this thing makes the perfect ballerina bun. And your can't see the thing through the hair either.  I'll keep buying these forever.

reviews.t: The small is a pretty good size to use
reviews.x: Works well and I had no trouble using it. Usually my hair never listens to me as I have dense and thick hair. I also have no skills in doing my hair (it's down 90% of the time and in a ponytail/bun 10% of the time) but it didn't take much practice before I learned how to use it well. The small is a pretty good size to use, although sometimes I have slightly too much hair for it to hold together with the small and have to upgrade to the large. I never struggle with the large.

reviews.t: Had to return this. It didn't even come close ...
reviews.x: Had to return this.  It didn't even come close to working for me.  I tried tying my hair up in a ponytail first, then tried just the top half of my hair the second time.... neither sizes will hold my hair in place.  As I tried to roll it, a ton of hair fell out of the hole.  I have thick, medium length hair with no layers.  Maybe it'll work for someone with thin hair that bends easier, but since there's no grip, I'm not sure how this would hold anyone's hair in place.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the bun makers quick and easy to use, working well even for those who struggle with hair styling.
The foam material grips and holds hair well across different hair types, including fine, thin, thick, and curly hair.
Some reviewers report the product requires practice and doesn't work for everyone, particularly with layered or long straight hair.
A few reviewers note durability concerns, with the internal wire frame warping or feeling flimsy after use.
Reviewers appreciate the value, noting the set includes multiple sizes and is inexpensive.
